subject: Byte (number of bits in)
notes: BitLayout.cs:30 BitsPerCharacter = 8; Characters(bits) = ceil(bits/8). The golden l1_byte_length_implicit_filler DISCRIMINATES the number: L77 legs PIC 1(12) BIT -> 2 and PIC 1(8) BIT -> 1 (so 8 <= bits-per-byte < 12) and ADJ3 (9 shared bits) -> 2 (so bits-per-byte < 9) — only 8 satisfies all three; its header already names Annex A.1 item 12.
